Compact home screen (no scroll) + rounded gear highlight + checklist sorting/collapse + compact Apple-style Settings

pending_fixes.label: Compact home screen: shrink the device-name/status hero card so the hero and entire setup checklist fit on one TV screen with no scrolling
Rounded settings gear focus highlight: replace the square selection highlight with a rounded/filled Apple-style focus state
Setup checklist ordering and collapse: incomplete items sort to the top, completed move below; when everything is complete, collapse the list to one green checkmark
Compact Apple-style Settings: redesign as a tighter grouped settings list like the Apple TV+ app for Android TV, several settings fitting on one screen

version_history.notes: First working build: iPhone keyboard text entry, push-to-talk voice on TV mics, Android 14 crash fix, in-app updater, trackpad tuning, Gemini assist
Apple TV-style UI refresh, updates moved to Settings, PC setup wizard page, large-text toggle option
Onboarding walkthrough with animated checklist for first-time setup
Auto-start on TV boot, automatic update check on launch, Wi-Fi network hint, built-in remote control guide
PC setup page can now enable accessibility directly via ADB commands
Apple TV trackpad feel improvements, keyboard reappears reliably on reconnect, power button can wake the TV
TV stays reachable during sleep so the iPhone power button can wake it
PC setup ADB command now preserves other accessibility services instead of replacing them
AirPlay-style home screen, tappable status rows with D-pad navigation fix
Visual focus highlight for D-pad, fixed cut-off pairing steps text
iPhone help note, Settings update badge, update notification, live status auto-refresh
Circular update progress ring, D-pad navigation fixes, layered wake-from-sleep
Trackpad sensitivity fix (one step per swipe, dead zone, step pause, slider), bridge auto-start, Paired status with checkmark, setup checklist on home, home layout cleanup

changes: Trackpad sensitivity fix (one step per swipe, dead zone, step pause, slider)
notes: Trackpad calmed down: one swipe moves exactly one item, with a bigger dead zone and a short pause between steps
New trackpad sensitivity slider in Settings, from Calm to Quick
Bridge now starts on its own when the app opens and after a TV reboot; accessibility stays the only requirement
Home screen shows a green Paired checkmark once an iPhone pairs, and the pairing steps hide
Home screen setup checklist mirrors the PC setup page, with checkmarks for each step
Home screen cleanup: no more tiny scroll, Apple-style settings gear, footer removed
